calibration: No fitted parameters or outcome-dependent pose selection
excluded: Ki20227 in AURKA is a racemate with undefined stereochemistry in primary pools
input: Native Late, first reported pose, all prespecified receptor/seed blocks
quadrature: Nested scrambled Sobol over seven independent unit dimensions. fixed scramble seed 40721. Haar conditional angular CDF (theta-sin(theta))/(cap-sin(cap)).
ablation: joint rigid + hinge with free reference
endpoint: Vina affinity plus the normalized local work using the same Vina flexibility divisor inside the integrand. For each ligand, average the two receptor medians over the four seeds, then assess >=3-fold same-assay Kd directions, ranks and relative gap MAE.
interpretation: One bounded top-pose neighborhood, one allowed internal torsion, frozen remaining internal coordinates; no absolute standard-state affinity, solvent, receptor states, or basin summation.
prospective_transfer: S6K1 (Davis Table 4): all exact measured rows among the previously frozen 25 prepared kinase inhibitors, exclude racemate Ki-20227 and the donor staurosporine. 3A60 unphosphorylated human chain A; two fixed seeds 271828,314159, 26 A box, two trajectories 25000 evaluations each; first mode only. One receptor. Known-site, dry rigid receptor.
coupled_hinge: Select the declared rotor of greatest reduced axial heavy-atom moment Jl Jr/(Jl+Jr). Apply opposite axial-moment-weighted rotations of its two branches around the bond followed by centroid restoration. Locally sample +/-30 degrees, 16 midpoint nodes. Integrate the joint rigid and hinge increment then subtract the free intramolecular-only integral over the same 16 internal states. Restrict macrocycles to rigid motion until ring closure can be preserved.
